roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers an exciting opportunity to lead both staff education and infection prevention initiatives within a supportive environment.

In this dual-focused position, you will play a crucial role in ensuring high standards of care through comprehensive staff training and robust infection control programs. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence. Join our team and make a significant impact on resident care and staff development.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or education
Minimum of 2 years of experience in infection prevention and control
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42, based on experience.
